title: Contraction Results For Solvability And Stability to Hilfer Fuzzy Fractional Control System With Infinite Continuous Delay
content:
For one of control fractional differential inclusion we assume the existence of mild solution
results according to contraction theorem.  Furthermore, we explore the necessary conditions to attain Ulam stability teste with respect to Mittage–Lefller functions.  All result will created due to infinite continuous delay and Solvability of FMQH-inequalities.
